rationale: OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions (stable since 2025) + OpenInference evaluator-span kinds. Sub-5 sweep cites these as the 2026 canonical contracts that LangSmith / Braintrust / Phoenix / MLflow 3.0 / Pydantic Evals all consume.

required_per_llm_call_span._comment: OpenTelemetry GenAI attribute names. gen_ai.system is DEPRECATED; use gen_ai.provider.name.
fields: gen_ai.request.model       (what we ASKED for, e.g. gemini-2.5-flash-002)
implementation_fingerprint (sha of the eval code path)

google_gemini.reliability: alias resolution only; no infra-config fingerprint exists in 2026
google_gemini.mitigation: pin to DATED alias (e.g. gemini-2.5-flash-002), reject runs where response.modelVersion is null or differs from request

anthropic_claude.reliability: reliable; Anthropic version-pins via dated suffix (e.g. claude-haiku-4-5-20251001)
anthropic_claude.mitigation: request must equal response; reject otherwise

openai_chatgpt.reliability: LOW; not unique across infra config, missing for some models
openai_chatgpt.note: Logged for posterity only. Not used in zettel_eval_v1 v1.

non_negotiable_invariants: Every llm_calls row MUST have non-null response_model unless the SDK does not surface it; null response_model triggers a per-run report flag.
cache_hit=1 rows DO NOT increment cost_usd or token counts; aggregate cost dashboards must filter cache_hit=0.
All ISO timestamps are UTC (Z suffix).
All sha256 fields are lowercase hex (no \x prefix).
